canonical.item_noop: {actor} did not put the {item} in the {box}.
canonical.query_item: Who holds the box with the {item}?

fresh_destination_first.item_init: The {box} is where the {item} can be found.
fresh_destination_first.item_noop: Into the {box} the {item} did not go when {actor} tried to move it.
fresh_destination_first.item_write: Into the {box} went the {item} when {actor} moved it.
fresh_destination_first.owner_noop: To {owner} from {source}: the {box} did not change hands.
fresh_destination_first.query_box: Give the name of the person with the {box}.
fresh_destination_first.query_item: Give the name of the person with the box around the {item}.

fresh_passive_delivery.item_noop: Into the {box}, the {item} was not deposited by {actor}.
fresh_passive_delivery.item_write: Into the {box}, the {item} was deposited by {actor}.
fresh_passive_delivery.owner_noop: From {source}, the {box} was not delivered to {owner}.
fresh_passive_delivery.query_item: By whom is the container holding the {item} owned?

fresh_retention_contrast.item_noop: {actor} abandoned moving the {item}; its intended destination was the {box}.
fresh_retention_contrast.item_write: {actor} finished moving the {item}; its destination was the {box}.
fresh_retention_contrast.query_item: Who has possession of the box containing the {item}?

fresh_status_front.item_noop: Aborted placement: {actor} moved the {item} into the {box}.
fresh_status_front.item_write: Successful placement: {actor} moved the {item} into the {box}.
fresh_status_front.query_box: Identify the current holder of the {box}.
fresh_status_front.query_item: Identify the current holder of the container with the {item}.

matched_completion.item_init: The location of the {item} is the {box}.
matched_completion.item_noop: {actor}'s placement of the {item} in the {box} was cancelled.
matched_completion.item_write: {actor}'s placement of the {item} in the {box} was completed.
matched_completion.owner_noop: The handover of the {box} from {source} to {owner} was cancelled.
matched_completion.owner_write: The handover of the {box} from {source} to {owner} was completed.
matched_completion.query_item: Which person owns the container that contains the {item}?

matched_recipient.item_noop: The {item} never went into the {box}, despite {actor}'s plan.
matched_recipient.item_write: The {item} went into the {box}, placed by {actor}.
matched_recipient.query_item: Name the owner of the container of the {item}.
